WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT home_store_id, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS nd, min(valid_from), max(valid_from),
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date='2026-09-25') AS all_versions_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date='2026-09-25') AS all_distinct
FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date='2026-09-25'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (
  SELECT member_id, count(*) AS versions, count(DISTINCT join_date) AS join_dates, min(join_date) AS jd_min, max(join_date) AS jd_max, min(valid_from) AS first_valid
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id)
SELECT 'on25' AS k, count(*) AS members, sum(CASE WHEN join_dates>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_jd, sum(CASE WHEN first_valid<>jd_min THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fv_mismatch, sum(CASE WHEN versions>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_ver
FROM per WHERE jd_min='2026-09-25' OR jd_max='2026-09-25' OR first_valid='2026-09-25'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'overall', count(*), sum(CASE WHEN join_dates>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN first_valid<>jd_min THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN versions>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM per
UNION ALL
SELECT 'daily '||CAST(join_date AS VARCHAR), count(DISTINCT member_id), 0,0,0 FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN '2026-09-20' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY join_date
ORDER BY 1
